check_session_history_the_session_list_a: Check session history, the session list and the original environment first. Clearing only removes this browser's pending record; it does not stop or resubmit tasks.
this_session_is_still_running_wait_or_in: This session is still running. Wait or interrupt normally before checking.
i_checked_history_and_the_original_envir: I checked history and the original environment; no further verification is needed
refresh_status_to_check_the_compatibilit: Refresh status to check the compatibility confirmation. This record does not represent task execution and will not be automatically resubmitted.
this_task_is_still_running_use_the_inter: This task is still running. Use the interrupt button in the input area.
checked_at_original_submission_status_pr: Checked at {{v0}}. {{v1}} Original submission status preserved.
refresh_the_session_list_and_check_for_a: Refresh the session list and check for a new session containing the original history. Checking this fork will not stop or change the original task.
tasks_will_not_be_resent_automatically_c: Tasks will not be resent automatically. Check history and the original environment before reconciling.
i_checked_the_session_list_and_history_a: I checked the session list and history and verified this fork's result
i_verified_that_the_previous_execution_h: I verified that the previous execution has ended
fork_result_checked_manually_original_ta: Fork result checked manually. Original task state unchanged.
checking_session_history_and_submission_: Checking session history and submission receipts…
session_state_still_needs_checking_inspe: This conversation’s state is still unconfirmed. Check again or inspect its history.
check_submission_records_reconciliation_: Check submission records; reconciliation does not resend tasks.
log_in_to_codex_on_the_server_computer: Log in to Codex on the server computer
your_login_expired_or_the_gateway_return: Your login expired or the gateway returned a login page. Log in again to reconnect.
submission_cannot_be_confirmed_record_no: Submission cannot be confirmed: record not found (404 / OPERATION_NOT_FOUND). The request may not have arrived or service data may have changed; this does not prove the task was not executed.
unrecognized_server_message_check_versio: Unrecognized server message. Check version compatibility.
could_not_parse_a_live_message_refresh_t: Could not parse a live message. Refresh the session snapshot.
this_history_chunk_does_not_belong_to_th: This history chunk does not belong to the current session.
history_pagination_did_not_advance_retry: History pagination did not advance. Retry syncing the session.
httpFailure: Request failed ({{code}}). Check the operation and service status before retrying.
invalidName: Session names must be nonempty, contain no line breaks and be at most 100 characters.
unsupportedSchema: This form schema is unsupported. Check technical details or cancel the request.
AUTH_REQUIRED: Your login expired. Log in again and retry.
ACTION_EXPIRED: This request expired. Refresh the session and retry.
ACTION_CONFLICT: The request state changed. Check the session before proceeding.
THREAD_IN_USE: This session is in use by another process. Retry after it is released, or fork saved history.
THREAD_BUSY: The session is running or has pending requests. Resolve them before retrying.
THREAD_ARCHIVED: This session is archived. Unarchive it first.
THREAD_NOT_FOUND: Session not found. Refresh the session list.
PROJECT_UNAVAILABLE: The project directory is unavailable. Check the server path and permissions.
INVALID_PROJECT_PATH: Invalid project path. Check the absolute server path and access permissions.
WORK_DIR_UNAVAILABLE: The workDir directory is missing, is not a directory, or cannot be accessed. Check the directory and permissions on the service host, or enter another absolute path.
PROJECT_EXISTS: This directory is already a project. Use the existing project or choose another directory.
PROJECT_NOT_FOUND: Project not found. Refresh the project list.
PROJECT_BUSY: The project has running tasks or unconfirmed operations. Resolve them first.
RESULT_UNKNOWN: Submission result unconfirmed. Reconcile it before submitting again.
OPERATION_BUSY: Operation in progress. Wait for the submission receipt.
COMPATIBILITY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Confirm the current Codex compatibility notice first.
CONFIG_CONFLICT: Another process changed the configuration. Reload it before saving.
CONFIG_READ_ONLY: The current configuration is read only and cannot be saved.
CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot access configuration. Check the file and service permissions.
INVALID_CONFIG: Invalid configuration. Check field values, networking and authentication.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Input does not meet the requirements. Check it and retry.
UPDATE_MAINTENANCE: The service is updating. Wait for it to recover before retrying.
PERMISSION_MODE_UNAVAILABLE: This permission mode is unavailable under current capabilities or managed policy.
BODY_TOO_LARGE: The request is too large. Reduce images or text and retry.
SHELL_BUSY: A Shell command is running. Wait or interrupt it.
SHELL_NOT_FOUND: Shell execution record not found. Check the result on the server.
IMAGE_NOT_FOUND: The image file does not exist or was deleted.
IMAGE_UNREADABLE: The image file cannot be read.
UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE_TYPE: Only PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF images are supported.
UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please retry later.
READ_FAILED: Session history cannot be read right now. Please retry.
EXPORT_FAILED: Could not read the complete history. No file was downloaded. Please retry later.
MARKDOWN_NOT_FOUND: The file does not exist or was deleted.
JSON_NOT_FOUND: The file does not exist or was deleted.
MARKDOWN_TOO_LARGE: This Markdown file exceeds the 2 MiB preview limit.
JSON_TOO_LARGE: This JSON file exceeds the 2 MiB preview limit.
INVALID_REPOSITORY: Enter an HTTPS or SSH Git repository URL. Use the host’s existing credentials; do not include passwords, tokens or query parameters.
CLONE_PARENT_UNAVAILABLE: The destination’s parent directory must exist, and the service needs write and directory access.
CLONE_TARGET_EXISTS: The destination is not an empty regular directory. Choose a new or empty directory; existing files will not be overwritten.
CLONE_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot inspect the destination. Check the server path and access permissions.
CLONE_IN_PROGRESS: This directory is being cloned. Wait for completion or cancel before continuing.
CLONE_ID_CONFLICT: This operation ID belongs to another clone request.
GATEWAY_STOPPING: The service is stopping. Please try again later.
CLONE_LIMIT: Several repositories are already being cloned. Wait for one to finish and try again.
CLONE_NOT_FOUND: Clone record not found. After a service restart, check the destination and add it as an existing directory, or retry with a new empty directory.
WORKSPACE_UNAVAILABLE: The session’s working directory is unavailable. Check its server path and permissions, then try again.
CLONE_GIT_MISSING: Git is not installed on the server or is absent from the service’s PATH. Install or configure Git and retry with an empty directory. No project was added; inspect any remaining files first.
CLONE_AUTH_FAILED: Git authentication failed or access was denied. Configure Git credentials or SSH keys on the server. No project was added; inspect the destination before retrying with a new empty directory.
CLONE_HOST_KEY_FAILED: SSH host verification failed. Verify and configure the repository host’s SSH trust on the server. No project was added; inspect the destination before retrying with an empty directory.
CLONE_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE: The repository does not exist or is inaccessible. Check its URL and the server’s Git permissions. No project was added; inspect the destination before retrying with an empty directory.
CLONE_NETWORK_FAILED: Cannot connect to the Git repository. Check the server’s network, proxy and certificates. No project was added; inspect the destination before retrying with an empty directory.
CLONE_TARGET_NOT_EMPTY: Git stopped because the destination contains files. Existing files were not overwritten or deleted. No project was added; check the destination and retry with a new empty directory.
CLONE_DISK_FULL: The server has insufficient disk space. Free space, inspect any remaining files and retry with a new empty directory. No project was added.
CLONE_FAILED: Git cloning failed. Check the repository URL, server credentials, directory permissions and disk space. No project was added; inspect remaining files before retrying with a new empty directory.
CLONE_REGISTRATION_FAILED: Project registration failed. Cloned files remain in the destination. Retry adding the project without cloning again, or use “Existing directory”.
CLONE_TIMED_OUT: Cloning exceeded 30 minutes and was stopped. No project was added and no files were deleted. Inspect the destination and retry with a new empty directory.
CLONE_CANCELLED: No project was added and no files were deleted. Files may remain in the destination; inspect it before retrying with a new empty directory.
BACKUP_BUSY: A backup is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
BACKUP_UNAVAILABLE: Backups are unavailable. Check the service configuration and technical details.
BACKUP_FAILED: The backup failed. Check configuration, directory permissions and disk space before retrying.
BACKUP_INVALID: The backup is damaged, incomplete or incompatible and cannot be restored.
BACKUP_TIMEOUT: Timed out waiting for a safe point. Try again after active tasks finish.
BACKUP_MAINTENANCE: A backup is in progress. Try again after it finishes.
PROJECT_ORDER_CONFLICT: The project list has changed. Refresh it and try reordering again.
TEXT_NOT_FOUND: The text file does not exist or was deleted.
TEXT_TOO_LARGE: This text file exceeds the 2 MiB preview limit.
TEXT_UNREADABLE: The text file cannot be read. Check its permissions.
INVALID_TEXT_CONTENT: The file is not valid UTF-8 text or contains binary data.
UNSUPPORTED_TEXT_TYPE: This file type is not supported by the text preview.
INVALID_TEXT_PATH: The text file path is invalid.
TEXT_OUTSIDE_PROJECT: Only files in this session’s project or server temporary directories can be previewed.
TEXT_CHANGED: The text file changed. Reopen the preview.
TEXT_NOT_FILE: The text file path is not a regular file.
AGENTS_EXISTS: AGENTS.md already exists. The existing entry was preserved.
AGENTS_CHECK_FAILED: Could not verify AGENTS.md. Initialization was not submitted.
GIT_NOT_REPOSITORY: This workspace is not a Git working tree.
GIT_UNAVAILABLE: Git is unavailable on the server.
GIT_DIFF_FAILED: Could not read workspace changes. Retry after checking the working directory.
DENIAL_EXPIRED: This denial is no longer available. Reopen the current session’s denial list.
RECAP_BUSY: A recap is already running for this session.
RECAP_FAILED: The recap could not be completed. The source conversation is unchanged.
GOAL_UNAVAILABLE: Goals are unavailable or disabled in the current Codex runtime.
GOAL_CONFLICT: The goal changed. Reload its current state before editing.
GOAL_BUSY: Another goal update is pending. Wait for its receipt.
SKILL_UNAVAILABLE: A selected skill is no longer available in this workspace. Refresh and select it again.
SKILLS_READ_FAILED: Could not read skills. Refresh and try again.
SKILL_STEER_UNSUPPORTED: Codex 0.164.0 cannot apply a selected skill during an active task. Wait for it to finish, then send this draft.
QUESTION_EXPIRED: This question is no longer available. Refresh the session.
QUESTION_BUSY: An answer is submitting or awaiting confirmation. Refresh its receipt before continuing.
QUESTION_CONFLICT: This question was handled or is already submitting. Refresh the session.
FILE_REFERENCE_OUTSIDE: The selected file is outside this workspace. Select it again.
FILE_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: The file was moved or deleted. Select another file.
FILE_REFERENCE_UNREADABLE: The selected file cannot be read. Check its permissions.
FILE_REFERENCE_CHANGED: The file or workspace changed. Select the file again.
FILE_SEARCH_BUSY: File search is busy. Retry shortly.
FILE_SEARCH_TIMEOUT: File search timed out. Narrow the path and retry.
recovery_missing: The server cannot find this submission record, so its result is unconfirmed.
recovery_unreachable: This submission cannot be checked right now. Reconnect and try again.
recovery_execution_unknown: No matching record has confirmed that this task ended.
recovery_receipt_unknown: No definite result has been received for this operation.
recovery_running: This conversation still has an active task. Open it to view or stop the task.
recovery_go_to_thread: Open the related conversation to inspect its history and handle this submission.
recovery_retry_connection: The restriction stays until checks recover. Nothing will be resubmitted automatically.
recovery_action_owner_missing: The old record has no conversation reference. Check the result in the conversation containing the approval.
recovery_clear_effect: This removes only this pending record from the current browser. It does not stop a task or resend anything. The original operation may have executed; submitting again could execute it twice.
recovery_fork_effect: Check the conversation list and related history to confirm the fork result. This only ends waiting for that fork. It does not stop the source task or create another fork.
recovery_restore_effect: Check the related history and confirm that the previous task ended. Continuing releases only that task’s old reservation. It does not stop or resend the task. The server still refuses to release a known active task.
recovery_confirm_ended: Confirm previous task ended and restore
recovery_responding: This approval or input response is still awaiting confirmation and cannot be submitted again yet.
